custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a custom role from before this release, role A, with View and Create & Edit ticked and Delete unticked in the parts inventory group.
  • Have a screenshot of role A's permissions taken before this release, so they can be compared.
  • Use a second browser, or a private window, signed in as user B, who has had role A since before this release.
  • Start on Roles & Permissions (click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu).

Setup

  1. Find a role from before this release: Click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Roles & Permissions in the left menu. The roles listed with Role Type Custom came with this site's data; open one with the edit icon to read its Parts Department boxes.
